task: Write a Teams message (20–35 words) to your colleague Tom. Your train is stopped at Newmarket and you'll be about 10 minutes late for the Harbour Council call. Ask him to start without you.
zh: 给同事 Tom 写一条 Teams 消息（20–35 词）。你的火车停在 Newmarket，Harbour Council 的会议你会晚到大约 10 分钟。请他先开始，不用等你。
example: Hi Tom, I'm running about 10 minutes late. My train's stopped at Newmarket. Could you start the Harbour Council call without me? I'll jump on as soon as I can.

task: Write a Teams message (15–30 words) to Raj. You need the subscription ID for the Kauri Foods test environment so you can set up monitoring. Ask him to send it by the end of today.
zh: 给 Raj 写一条 Teams 消息（15–30 词）。你需要 Kauri Foods 测试环境的订阅 ID 来配置监控。请他今天下班前发给你。
example: Hi Raj, could you send me the subscription ID for the Kauri Foods test environment? I need it to set up monitoring. End of today would be great. Thanks!

task: Write a polite nudge on Teams (25–45 words) to Aroha, a client contact. You sent her firewall change request CHG-2041 on Tuesday and she hasn't approved it yet. You need approval by Thursday to use Saturday night's change window.
zh: 在 Teams 上给客户联系人 Aroha 写一条礼貌的催促消息（25–45 词）。你周二把防火墙变更申请 CHG-2041 发给了她，她还没批。你需要她周四前批准，才能用上周六晚上的变更窗口。
example: Hi Aroha, just checking in on change request CHG-2041 that I sent on Tuesday. If you can approve it by Thursday, we can use Saturday night's change window. Happy to jump on a quick call if you have any questions.

task: Your manager Sarah asks on Teams: "Did the backup for the Harbour Council file server run last night?" Reply (15–30 words). It finished at 2:14am, backed up 1.2 TB and had no errors.
zh: 经理 Sarah 在 Teams 上问：“Harbour Council 文件服务器的备份昨晚跑了吗？”回复她（15–30 词）。备份在凌晨 2:14 完成，备份了 1.2 TB，没有报错。
example: Yes, it ran fine. The backup finished at 2:14am, 1.2 TB in total, with no errors. I'll keep an eye on tonight's run as well.

task: Write a Teams message (15–35 words) to Tom asking for a quick call. You keep getting a VPN error when you connect to the Kauri Foods network for the payroll upgrade. You need about 10 minutes before 3pm.
zh: 给 Tom 写一条 Teams 消息（15–35 词），约个简短的通话。你为了薪资系统升级连接 Kauri Foods 网络时一直报 VPN 错误。你需要在下午 3 点前占用他大约 10 分钟。
example: Hey Tom, have you got 10 minutes for a quick call before 3pm? I keep getting a VPN error when I connect to the Kauri Foods network, and I'm stuck on the payroll upgrade.

task: Write a Teams message (20–40 words) to your colleague Priya to thank her. She stayed until 9pm last night to help you restore the Kauri Foods payroll database after a failed update.
zh: 给同事 Priya 写一条 Teams 消息（20–40 词）表示感谢。昨晚一次更新失败后，她陪你待到晚上 9 点，帮你恢复了 Kauri Foods 的薪资数据库。
example: Hi Priya, thanks heaps for staying back last night to help me restore the payroll database. I really appreciate it, and I couldn't have done it that fast without you. Coffee's on me this week!

task: Ben asked you yesterday how many Microsoft 365 E3 licences the Harbour Council tenant has. You were in workshops all day and didn't reply. Write a Teams message (25–45 words): say sorry for the slow reply and give the answer: 42 licences, 6 of them unassigned.
zh: Ben 昨天问你 Harbour Council 租户有多少个 Microsoft 365 E3 许可证。你昨天一整天都在开研讨会，没回复。写一条 Teams 消息（25–45 词）：为回复晚了道歉，并给出答案：一共 42 个，其中 6 个未分配。
example: Hi Ben, sorry for the slow reply, I was stuck in workshops all day yesterday. Harbour Council has 42 E3 licences, and 6 of them are unassigned at the moment. Let me know if you need the user list.

task: Your manager Grace messages you: the client says the Kauri Foods ordering app is very slow this morning. Reply on Teams (15–30 words). Say you're on it and you'll send an update in 30 minutes.
zh: 经理 Grace 发消息给你：客户说今天上午 Kauri Foods 的订货应用非常慢。在 Teams 上回复她（15–30 词）。说你正在处理，30 分钟后给她更新。
example: Thanks Grace, I'm on it. I'm checking the app service and database metrics now. I'll send you an update in 30 minutes.

task: Write a Teams message (25–45 words) to Raj, who invited you to a vendor demo on Friday at 2pm. It clashes with the Harbour Council cutover. Decline politely and ask if he can share the recording.
zh: 给 Raj 写一条 Teams 消息（25–45 词）。他邀请你参加周五下午 2 点的供应商演示，但和 Harbour Council 的割接时间冲突。礼貌地拒绝，并问他能不能分享录像。
example: Hi Raj, thanks for the invite. Unfortunately I can't make Friday at 2pm because I'm on the Harbour Council cutover all afternoon. Could you share the recording afterwards? I'd love to catch up on it next week.

task: Write a handover message (40–60 words) in the team's Teams channel. You're on leave from Monday 7 December to Friday 11 December. Raj will cover your Kauri Foods tickets. Your notes are in the Kauri Foods OneNote. Only call your mobile if it's urgent.
zh: 在团队的 Teams 频道里写一条交接消息（40–60 词）。你 12 月 7 日（周一）到 12 月 11 日（周五）休假。Raj 会接手你的 Kauri Foods 工单。你的笔记在 Kauri Foods 的 OneNote 里。只有紧急情况才打你手机。
example: Hi team, just a heads-up that I'm on leave from Monday 7 to Friday 11 December. Raj is covering my Kauri Foods tickets while I'm away, and all my notes are in the Kauri Foods OneNote. If something's really urgent, feel free to call my mobile. Thanks!

task: Write a Teams message (20–40 words) to your manager Grace. Your one-on-one with her is on Wednesday at 11am, but a client workshop has been booked at the same time. Ask to move it and suggest Thursday morning.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一条 Teams 消息（20–40 词）。你和她的一对一会议在周三上午 11 点，但同一时间安排了一个客户研讨会。请求改时间，并建议改到周四上午。
example: Hi Grace, a client workshop has just been booked for Wednesday at 11am, so it clashes with our one-on-one. Would Thursday morning work for you instead? Any time before 12 is fine for me.

task: Write a Teams message (20–40 words) to Tom asking him to review your pull request before 4pm. It's a small change: it adds diagnostic settings to the Bicep template for the Harbour Council storage accounts.
zh: 给 Tom 写一条 Teams 消息（20–40 词），请他在下午 4 点前审核你的拉取请求。改动很小：在 Harbour Council 存储账户的 Bicep 模板里加了诊断设置。
example: Hi Tom, could you review my pull request before 4pm? It's a small one. It just adds diagnostic settings to the Bicep template for the Harbour Council storage accounts. Should only take you five minutes.

task: Write a Teams message (25–50 words) to Aroha sharing the draft design document for the Harbour Council landing zone. Ask for her comments by Friday, mainly on section 4 (networking).
zh: 给 Aroha 写一条 Teams 消息（25–50 词），分享 Harbour Council 着陆区的设计文档草稿。请她在周五前给意见，重点看第 4 部分（网络）。
example: Hi Aroha, here's the draft design document for the Harbour Council landing zone. Could you add your comments by Friday? I'd especially like your eyes on section 4, the networking part, as that's where I've made the most assumptions.

task: Post a reminder (25–50 words) in the cloud team's Teams channel. There's a change freeze from 15 December to 11 January. No production changes are allowed without approval from Grace.
zh: 在云团队的 Teams 频道发一条提醒（25–50 词）。12 月 15 日到 1 月 11 日是变更冻结期。没有 Grace 的批准，不能做任何生产环境变更。
example: Quick reminder, team: the change freeze starts on 15 December and runs until 11 January. During that time, please don't make any production changes without approval from Grace. If you've got changes planned, try to get them done before the 15th.

task: Write a Teams message (15–30 words) to your colleague Sarah. She just passed the AZ-305 exam after studying for three months. Congratulate her.
zh: 给同事 Sarah 写一条 Teams 消息（15–30 词）。她复习了三个月，刚刚通过了 AZ-305 考试。祝贺她。
example: Congrats on passing AZ-305, Sarah! That's a tough one, and three months of study really paid off. Well deserved. We should celebrate on Friday!

task: Write a message (15–30 words) in your team's Teams chat. You're working from home today because a plumber is coming. You're online all day and will join the stand-up on Teams.
zh: 在团队的 Teams 群聊里写一条消息（15–30 词）。你今天在家办公，因为有水管工要来。你全天在线，会在 Teams 上参加站会。
example: Morning all, I'm working from home today because I've got a plumber coming. I'm online all day and will join the stand-up on Teams.

task: Raj sent you a Teams message: "Can you move the VMs?" It's not clear what he means. Reply (20–40 words) and ask which VMs, which region, and by when.
zh: Raj 在 Teams 上给你发消息：“你能把那些虚拟机迁过去吗？”你不太清楚他的意思。回复他（20–40 词），问是哪些虚拟机、迁到哪个区域、什么时候前完成。
example: Hi Raj, happy to help. Just to make sure I get it right: which VMs do you mean, which region should they go to, and when do you need it done by?

task: Write a Teams message (15–30 words) to Mere at Kauri Foods. You've added her to the Finance-Reports security group as she asked. She needs to sign out and sign back in to see the reports.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Mere 写一条 Teams 消息（15–30 词）。你已经按她的要求把她加进了 Finance-Reports 安全组。她需要退出再重新登录才能看到报表。
example: Hi Mere, I've added you to the Finance-Reports group. Please sign out and sign back in, and you should see the reports. Let me know if they don't show up.

task: Write a Teams message (15–35 words) to Lisa, a client contact. Your 2pm call with her needs to start at 2:15 because your previous meeting is running over. Say sorry.
zh: 给客户联系人 Lisa 写一条 Teams 消息（15–35 词）。你和她下午 2 点的会议要推迟到 2:15 开始，因为你上一个会超时了。向她道歉。
example: Hi Lisa, sorry, my previous meeting is running over. Could we start our 2pm call at 2:15 instead? Apologies for the short notice.

task: Write a Teams message (15–30 words) to your manager Grace. Ask if she has five minutes today to talk about your workload next week. It's not urgent.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一条 Teams 消息（15–30 词）。问她今天有没有五分钟时间，聊聊你下周的工作量。不着急。
example: Hi Grace, have you got five minutes today to chat about my workload for next week? It's not urgent, so whenever suits you.

task: Lisa, a client contact, asks you on Teams when the new SQL server will be ready. You don't know yet. Reply (20–40 words): say you'll check with the build team and get back to her by 3pm.
zh: 客户联系人 Lisa 在 Teams 上问你新的 SQL 服务器什么时候能好。你还不知道。回复她（20–40 词）：说你会问一下搭建团队，下午 3 点前回复她。
example: Hi Lisa, good question. I'm not sure yet, so I'll check with the build team and get back to you by 3pm with a firm date.

task: This morning you told the team on Teams that the maintenance window is Saturday at 9pm. That was wrong: it's Sunday at 9pm. Write a correction (20–40 words).
zh: 今天早上你在 Teams 上告诉团队，维护窗口是周六晚上 9 点。说错了：实际上是周日晚上 9 点。写一条更正消息（20–40 词）。
example: Correction to my message this morning: the maintenance window is Sunday at 9pm, not Saturday. Sorry for the mix-up. The calendar invite has been updated as well.

task: Your colleague Tom has a lot of tickets this week and looks very busy. Write a Teams message (20–40 words) offering to take two of his tickets off him.
zh: 同事 Tom 这周工单很多，看起来很忙。写一条 Teams 消息（20–40 词），主动提出帮他接两个工单。
example: Hey Tom, looks like you've got a lot on this week. I've got a bit of space, so I'm happy to take a couple of your tickets. Just tell me which ones.

task: Write a Teams message (30–50 words) to Ben. You're leaving at 3pm for a doctor's appointment and will be back online at 5pm. The deployment pipeline for Kauri Foods is still running. Ask him to keep an eye on it.
zh: 给 Ben 写一条 Teams 消息（30–50 词）。你下午 3 点要去看医生，5 点回来上线。Kauri Foods 的部署流水线还在跑。请他帮忙盯一下。
example: Hi Ben, I'm heading out at 3pm for a doctor's appointment and will be back online around 5. The Kauri Foods deployment pipeline is still running. Could you keep an eye on it for me? If it fails, just send me a message.

task: Aroha is joining the cloud team on Monday. Write a welcome message (25–45 words) in the team channel. Say you'll be her buddy for the first few weeks and invite her for a coffee on Monday.
zh: Aroha 周一加入云团队。在团队频道写一条欢迎消息（25–45 词）。说你会在头几周当她的伙伴（buddy），并邀请她周一一起喝咖啡。
example: Welcome to the team, Aroha! Great to have you on board. I'll be your buddy for the first few weeks, so ask me anything, big or small. Let's grab a coffee on Monday morning.
